display.purpose: Case titles and top-level section headings only.

data.purpose: Selectors, IDs, hashes, timestamps, table cells. Never prose.

label.purpose: Uppercase badges and column heads, four words maximum.

shadows.name: pane
shadows.purpose: Resting surface: one specular cap, one contained shadow.

shadows.name: refracted-rim
shadows.purpose: The two axes read at the pane edge where glass would bend light. Hairline only.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Restores a visible ring wherever outline:none is set.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Default deceleration for state changes. No bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: blur-pane
motion.purpose: One blur value per elevation tier. Never escalated per component.

motion.name: data-change
motion.purpose: A data value snaps. Only state changes ease. A confidence bar's width is data; its authority colour is state.

components.name: Authority Chip
components.description: The ladder made visible. Colour plus icon plus word, always all three.
components.html: Verified Quarantined

components.name: Confidence Meter
components.description: Bar carries the tier colour; the numeral stays ink. Length says how big, hue says how trusted.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink ground, black text. Deliberately not the accent: a saturated fill is the cheapest object on a dark UI.

components.name: Composer
components.description: The one control permitted to glow. Indigo ring at full strength when it holds the caret.

narrative.overview: The product is an operations room at night. A true black ground, cold platinum ink, and one electric indigo that means LIVE, LINKED or ACTIVE. Depth never comes from lighter greys; it comes from light, as translucent films and low-alpha blooms stacked on a void. The system serves a single obligation stated in PRODUCT.md: the interface must never make unverified data look confirmed. Colour is spent on authority, never on magnitude. This is a forensic instrument panel, not a hacker movie prop.
keyCharacteristics: True black ground with tinted translucent panes floating on it
One indigo accent, used for state and never as a large painted fill
An eight-state authority ladder carrying colour plus icon plus word
Density without strain: an 11px reading floor, tabular numerals everywhere
Machined corners (13px on shared surfaces), never consumer rounding

rules.name: The Authority Rule
rules.body: Hue belongs to authority, not to magnitude. The authority ladder is the only scale permitted to spend colour on a verdict.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: One meaning per token. Aliasing across roles is how the ladder previously became the confidence ramp wearing a hat.

rules.name: The Light Source Rule
rules.body: Indigo is a light source, not a fill. As soon as it becomes a large painted area it stops meaning look here.

rules.name: The Two Axes Rule
rules.body: Indigo is evidence, violet is inference. Nothing else may claim either hue.

rules.name: The Data Face Rule
rules.body: Monospace is a data face, not a body face. Labels and prose stay in the sans.

rules.name: The Micro Floor Rule
rules.body: Never below 11px, and never small size plus heavy tracking plus reduced opacity together.

rules.name: The Glow Is State Rule
rules.body: A glow must map to something real. A glow with nothing behind it is the amateur tell.

rules.name: The Blur Budget Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur marks elevation, not surface. One intensity per tier.

rules.name: The Visible Ink Rule
rules.body: A gradient may never be the sole reason text is visible. The two sanctioned background-clip:text treatments ship with forced-colors, print and @supports fallbacks restoring solid ink.

dos: Do spend hue on the authority ladder and nothing else.
Do render every state with colour plus an icon plus a word.
Do keep the indigo as a rim, an edge, a bloom or an active state.
Do measure contrast through the composited glass, not each layer alone.
Do use the shared .panel material for any new surface.
Do keep monospace for values a reader compares character by character.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion alternative.
Do ship forced-colors, print and @supports fallbacks with any text relying on background-clip: text.
donts: Don't build generic SaaS dashboards (gradient hero metrics, identical card grids, purple-glow marketing shells).
Don't reach for Hollywood hacker cliche: neon-green matrix rain, glitch effects, scanline overlays, skull iconography, decorative typing animations.
Don't use glass/glow as generic decoration rather than a deliberate material with a budget.
Don't render a single-source lead with the same visual weight as a corroborated finding.
Don't use a border-left or border-right above 1px as a coloured accent on a card, list item, callout or alert.
Don't colour a confidence numeral by its value.
Don't give a quarantined row a confidence hue.
Don't round a data surface past 16px.
Don't let a new surface invent its own blur, radius or border alpha.
Don't animate a layout property to show a data change.
